text:
maria: oncall-bot just fired a bunch of SLO alerts for hosted-infer in eu-west-1, p99 5xx jump ~15m ago :rotating_light:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] hosted-infer.gateway.p99_5xx > 2% (SLO burn) - triggered at 2025-10-05T14:12:01Z
ashley: saw it too, dashboards show a 5xx tail starting ~14:05, concentrated on the edge LB -> inference-gateway hop
tariq: customer support just flagged multiple customers getting 502/504 in the last 20m, sending repro now
lee: can you paste the support repro?
support-bot: forwarded thread from #support: custA: failing requests with 502, sample curl: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Customer-ID: custA" https://api.redwood-infer.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`
maria: ok running that against euw1 endpoint locally... getting 502 with body header `x-rw-lb-reason: rate-limited`
ashley: interesting — rate-limited header from the edge. But rate limits for custA are not high. Any recent config change?
tariq: Ops pushed a loadbalancer config change at 13:58 that enabled a new global conn_limit feature (PR #3821), looks like it started ramping rules at 14:00
lee: logs show edge proxy returning 502 when the LB rejects upstream because it saw `x-client-concurrency` > 50 (our new cutover), and gateway then returns 502 instead of 429
maria: query I ran in logs (sourcetype=proxy) -> `count by status, target_cluster | where status >= 500` shows spike mostly with target_cluster=inference-gateway and status=502 between 14:05-14:20
ashley: can you paste the exact log line?
lee: example log: `2025-10-05T14:08:23Z proxy[euw1] conn=153 drop=CONN_LIMIT target=inference-gateway req_id=abc123 x-customer-id=custA status=502`
tariq: tracing gap noticed — many of these requests have no upstream spans. Sampling wasn't the issue, the proxy aborted before we could instrument -> explains trace coverage gap in the SLO dash
maria: immediate mitigation: rolling back conn_limit change in LB is fast. I'll flag rollback and put rule in maintenance, but need to inform support and customers
ashley: agree. Also fix the gateway to return 429 on conn_limit instead of 502 so SLO/alerts map correctly. Filed GH issue: redwood/edge-proxy#401 (assigning to ops)
lee: repro steps for QA post-rollback: 1) ensure conn_limit=off in LB 2) run `ab -n 200 -c 60 -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://euw1.api.redwood-infer.com/v1/generate` 3) expect sustained success, p95 latency < 400ms
support-bot: notifying affected customers with temp mitigation note
tariq: quick log query to confirm rollback success: `sourcetype=proxy target=inference-gateway | timechart count(status=502) by _time span=1m` -> after rollback should drop to baseline within 2 windows
maria: rollback scheduled and started at 14:25Z, monitoring now
oncall-bot: [RESOLVED] hosted-infer.gateway.p99_5xx returned to baseline at 14:28:05Z
ashley: follow-ups: (1) postmortem to include why LB sent 502 not 429 and why conn_limit default was aggressive for long-running inference streams, (2) add synthetic test to catch conn_limit regressions before cutover, (3) update alert runbook to include LB-change checklist
lee: I'll take the runbook update. tariq will own the postmortem and ops PR revert notes
tariq: taking postmortem, will include log queries, trace examples, and recommended config thresholds (conn_limit 200 for inference workloads)
maria: thanks everyone. I'll leave the channel open for 1h for any regressions. :white_check_mark:
